line_text: Biden entered office, home heating oil prices up 44%, gasoline prices up 33%, and electricity and natural gas, they're both up nearly 30%. Because of Joe Biden and the Democrats, America is now dependent on foreign countries to supply natural resources and energy that we have right here at home. President Trump's foreign policy of peace through strength maintained global order. Now our enemies take a look at Biden and all they see is a feeble, weak man. President Trump brought historic peace to the Middle East with the Abraham Accords. We moved the U.S. Embassy to Jerusalem and brought foreign nations together. Now, under Biden, the Middle East is on fire and the entire globe is on the brink of World War III. President Trump defused a nuclear North Korea and held communist China accountable. Putin didn't dare enter Ukraine under the 45th president's watch. Now, under Joe Biden and the Democrats, everything has gone to hell in a handbasket. Biden facilitated one of the most disastrous military operations in U.S. history by recklessly pulling out of Afghanistan. He left allies behind to be slaughtered by the Taliban and billions of dollars worth of weapons to be resources to be used to stoke terror throughout the world
quote: President Trump brought historic peace to the Middle East with the Abraham Accords
rationale: Restates a previous administration's own announced characterisation of one of its programs - the Abraham Accords as having brought historic peace - as settled, at the point where the comparative foreign-policy record of two administrations is exactly what the passage argues about. No independent measurement, no evaluation and no counterfactual is named, and further argument is built on top of it as if it were established. Mid-band: the claim is central to the argument, but the record is absent rather than declared unnecessary and nobody is delegitimised for asking.
